name: cascade-ai-architect
description: Designs source-grounded AI agents and agentic systems while delegating prompt authoring, evaluation execution, simulation, and harness integration to their owning plugins.

interface.shortDescription: Design bounded AI agents and agentic systems.
interface.longDescription: Design grounded agent capabilities, claims/actions behavior, Admission, Policy Engine orchestration, per-role context, runtime bindings, roles, skills, prompt/evaluation briefs and bounded improvement cycles. The host owns authority and execution; Quality owns independent semantic evaluation.
defaultPrompt: Design the smallest safe AI-agent architecture for this request.
Prepare an architecture-bound prompt brief for this agent.
Prepare an evaluation request for this agent architecture.
